action: ACN advises updating exposed systems quickly (or isolating them from the internet), prioritising actively exploited CVEs, putting management interfaces behind a VPN with MFA, and feeding its MISP indicators into SIEM and EDR.
exec: Italy's national CSIRT says it has seen mass compromise campaigns run by AI-driven autonomous agents, and lists 81 CVEs with PoC availability and active exploitation noted.
plain: Italy's national cyber agency says it has seen large-scale attacks carried out by autonomous AI agents, and tells organisations to patch exposed systems quickly.
summary: CSIRT Italia says it detected, in the national context, mass compromise campaigns carried out by autonomous agents orchestrated with AI. In the cases it observed directly, a large number of systems were compromised within a few hours. The bulletin lists 81 CVEs with PoC availability and active exploitation noted, names tools such as PentAGI and DeepSeek Harness, and publishes MISP feeds.
title: ACN bulletin: CSIRT Italia detects mass compromise campaigns by AI-orchestrated autonomous agents

validation.note: Primary source: the ACN/CSIRT Italia bulletin itself was read.

key_findings: CSIRT Italia detected mass compromise campaigns run by autonomous agents orchestrated with AI.
The agents automate the classic attack phases, explore several vectors in parallel and chain vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and compromised credentials.
In directly observed cases a large number of systems was compromised within a few hours.
The bulletin lists 81 CVEs with PoC availability and active exploitation noted.
recommendations: Update exposed systems quickly, or isolate or segment them and block outbound traffic.
Prioritise CVEs actively exploited in the observed campaigns.
Protect management interfaces with VPN and MFA; apply least privilege; keep offline or immutable backups.
Integrate the MISP feeds into SIEM, EDR, NDR, IDS/IPS and SOAR.
